原生 advisor 独立复核：采纳其 6 项必须修改（rev 解析、fork 可达性、比较页拆分、分支切换缺口、seed 计数生成方式、\n    渲染/文案节点约束），见下“决定”。\n\n## Plan（实施负责人在独立工作区承接）\n\n1. 预演：`PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH pnpm install`；基线 `pnpm test`；必要时 `pnpm e2e` 确认基线绿（M3 packet 记录 53532a0\n   时 Vitest 63/63、Playwright 21/21）。\n2. 后端：`modules/content/service.js`（行级 diff、merge base、rev 解析、范围历史、最近触碰 path 的提交）、\n   `modules/content/router.js`（commits/commit/diff/compare/branches）挂到同一 `/api/repos` 前缀；\n   先让 `backend/test/content.test.js` 绿，再补 `contents` 约定 4/5 更正。\n3. 前端：`RepoCommitsPage`（分支/文件范围）、`CommitDiffPage`、`CompareRevisionsPage` + 共享 diff 组件；\n   Code 页/目录页/文件页各一个 `Commits` 链接（计数 `aria-hidden` 徽标）、文件页“最近 commit”改为该 path 的提交、\n   `Branch` combobox 切换；`copy.ts` 增补（`Commits`、`Changed files`、`Compare changes`、`base`/`compare`、\n   `Added`/`Deleted`/`Unchanged`、`Branch`）；路由按 §7.2。\n4. hash（否则 id≥16 的 `0000010` 会被当十进制 10）；\n   其后纯数字按十进制 id，再按分支名；候选不存在则顺次下移，全部不命中 → 404。\n3. **解析域 = 本仓库分支可达 commit 集（advisor 修正）**：§9.1 fork 只复制分支指针，`commit.repo_id` 属源仓库；\n   若按 repo_id 过滤会让 fork Seeds are keyed by business identity and must be safe to run\n * repeatedly without overwriting data the user already produced (for example an\n * account whose password was changed through the UI must keep its new password\n * after a restart).\n */\nimport { transact } from '../db/index.js';\n\n/** @type {Map<string, (db: import('better-sqlite3').Database) => void>} */\nconst registry = new Map();\n\n/**\n * @param {string} name unique seed name, e.g. 'accounts'\n * @param {(db: import('better-sqlite3').Database) => void} fn idempotent seed body\n */\nexport function registerSeed(name, fn) {\n  if (registry.has(name)) {\n    throw new Error(`Seed \"${name}\" is already registered`);\n  }\n  registry.set(name, fn);\n}\n\nexport function registeredSeeds() {\n  return [...registry.keys()];\n}\n\n/**\n * Run every registered seed.
